description: This file defines a move-only function wrapper similar to std::move_only_function, with fallback implementation if the standard library does not support it. It includes internal handling for small object optimization, type erasure, and dynamic invocation, and is used within the uWebSockets project as uWS::MoveOnlyFunction.

classes.name: any_invocable
classes.description: A move-only, type-erased callable wrapper similar to std::move_only_function, with internal small object optimization and dynamic invocation capabilities.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the stored callable with provided arguments.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two move-only function objects.
